title: Freya and the Uniform
author: Lena Thornbury
blurb: Coral Dravenmoor, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
